items.title: Albert French Interview
items.q: Charlie Hampton played piano with us.

ctx.x: That's near where the Budweiser was. Yeah where the Budweiser was.

I knew that place. Well after we left there then we moved to Exchange Alley. And I was still working with Willie Gilders. I worked with Willie Gilders about three and a half years. And Poissy Alfre, you know Poissy Alfre? Oh yes. Yeah I worked with Poissy. Poissy was there. And Sidney Carrere, that's the one you don't hear them talk about. No. Sidney Carrere, he's a fine tenor man, he had a brother, Professor Carrere. I think they both passed. I think so too. I never did meet either of them. Yeah well Sidney…
